long_biography.plain_text:
Times Navigation was established around Yiannis Karageorgis's long experience in Greek shipping. The company combines technical and operational management with commercial relationships across charterers, traders, insurers and brokers. Its model keeps fleet management, crewing and maintenance within one private organisation.

Karageorgis's role extends from asset strategy to the standards applied at sea and ashore. The business emphasises trained crews, retention and a shared management system for shore staff and seafarers. It also frames performance through transport reliability, safety and environmental protection, placing operational discipline at the centre of his work as a shipowner.

uncertainties.detail: Public sources render the first name as Yiannis, Giannis, Ioannis or John G. The uncommon surname, Greek identity and repeated Times Navigation leadership role connect those forms at 93 confidence, while unrelated property, engineering, cybersecurity and Olympic-sailing namesakes have incompatible careers or life details.

The immutable record gives August 1950, but no strong independent public source found during this research confirmed the full date or birthplace. No birth detail is proposed, and the existing date is not presented in either biography.

Historical Karageorgis shipping businesses and a separate marine-electronics company involve other people with the surname. No reliable source proves that Yiannis Karageorgis inherited either platform or is related to those families, so wealth origin remains Unknown and no family role is inferred.

Times Navigation was established in 2013 around its unnamed principal's long experience, but the strongest neutral sources identify Karageorgis specifically as president, managing director and shipowner-leader rather than explicitly as founder. Operator is therefore used without forcing a founder classification.

Times Navigation's official site does not name its principal. Independent reports identify Karageorgis as managing director in 2020 and president in 2024, supporting the combined known-for title at 94 rather than 100 confidence.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X or personal website met the identity and ownership threshold. The most visible exact-name LinkedIn profile belongs to a Cyprus property professional, so only the official Times Navigation company website is proposed.
Both biographies omit vessel facts, transaction amounts, fleet counts, current asset values, net-worth figures, politics, allegations, controversies, legal matters and sensitive private information.
